definitions.full: H3788. kishron כִּשְׁרוֺן noun [masculine] skill, success ; — 1 skill , וּבְכִשְׁר֑וֺן וּבְדַעַת בְּחָכְמָה Eccl 2:21 ; construct הַמַּעֲשֶׂה כָּלכִּֿשְׁרוֺן 4:4 all skill of work = skilful work. 2 success, profit , לִבְעָלָיהָ וּמַהכִּֿשְׁרוֺן Eccl 5:10 and what profit have the owners of it ?
